plugin.note: Ghosts have low Defence and 25 Hitpoints, so any melee weapon clears them. They are undead, so a salve amulet helps. Air spells exploit the 50% elemental weakness for a Magic-training alternative.

requirements: Combat level 13 is required to be assigned Ghosts.
No Slayer level or quest requirement for the base task.
Some ghost spawns are inside the Wilderness; a non-Wilderness spot avoids PKers.
mechanics: Ghosts are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead both apply.
Ghosts have a 50% elemental weakness to air spells (magic defence -5).
They attack with melee (crush) at 4 ticks and have a max hit of 2.
Ghosts drop nothing at most locations, so the task is done for Slayer XP and streak, not loot.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill the level-19 Ghosts with any melee weapon at a low-level spot such as the Draynor Manor basement.
steps: Travel to a Ghost spawn (e.g. Draynor Manor basement).
Kill the level-19 Ghosts; max hit 2 means minimal food is needed.
Wear a salve amulet for an undead damage bonus if you have one.
notes: Avoid Wilderness ghost spawns unless comfortable with PK risk.

methods.label: Air spells
methods.summary: Cast air spells to exploit the 50% elemental weakness while training Magic.
requiredOrKeyItems: Air staff and runes, or a trident
steps: Bring an air staff (or trident) and attack the Ghosts with air spells.
The 50% air weakness and -5 magic defence make Magic accurate and fast.
notes: A salve amulet (i) also boosts magic damage against these undead.
